recap.text: Carl puts off opening his boxes to have a distraction, while everyone else has already opened their platinum quest boxes, mostly spells. Donut's holds a tome of Twinkle Toes, a cheap spell that makes Mongo, or any other minion, run really fast for as many seconds as her intelligence level, and she is pretty excited. Katia gets a spell called Hanzo, Louis and Firas get spells too, and Gwen gets a new spear.

Carl drives the chariot down the main road while Donut rides Mongo alongside. Her Twinkle Toes spell makes Mongo run faster than the dune buggy, and she has been practicing it to level it up. Mongo screeches with joy each time she casts it. Carl stops a few times to plant claymore-like mines that only hunters will trigger.

Donut rides Mongo to the left of Bautista's carriage, her Twinkle Toes active and Mongo more buff with the Muscle Mommy benefit. On the other side Dong rides Gonk, the swamp yak, which runs astonishingly fast under his own Twinkle Toes while Bigs whoops on its head. Jamal holds up the rear on his spider legs, spurting little bursts of flame.

Donut, who has the Twinkle Toes spell and a level 15 Heal Critter, argues that the animal is the best choice when the party leader must pick a vehicle, mechanical or biological, though Mongo won't like another animal in the party. Hedy the gremlin gasps from the garage floor that pet spells don't work on special mounts, then clocks the other gremlin with a mallet. Neither Twinkle Toes nor Heal Critter will work on them.

beats.headline: Faster than the buggy
beats.text: Carl drives the chariot down the main road while Donut rides Mongo alongside. Her Twinkle Toes spell lets Mongo run faster even than the dune buggy, and she has been practicing it, trying to level it up. Mongo loves going fast and screeches with joy whenever she casts the spell. Carl stops a few times to plant claymore-like mines that only hunters will trigger.
beats.gist: Donut casts Twinkle Toes, and Mongo outruns the dune buggy, screeching with joy.

beats.headline: Two riders, two spells

On the other side Dong rides Gonk, his own Twinkle Toes active, making the swamp yak run astonishingly fast, while Bigs whoops on the yak's head. Jamal holds up the rear on his spider legs, spurting little bursts of flame.

beats.headline: Not for special mounts

Donut thinks the animal is the best choice: she has the Twinkle Toes spell and a level 15 Heal Critter, though Mongo won't like another animal in the party. Pet spells don't work on special mounts, Hedy the gremlin gasps from the garage floor, and clocks the other gremlin with a mallet. Neither Twinkle Toes nor Heal Critter will work on them.
